note: Hand-written task recipes for Pip, drafted from the official documentation listed in each recipe's source. status is "drafted" until someone has followed the recipe on a real account and filled in verifiedOn, verifiedBy and verifiedWith. Interfaces change: Pip trusts the exact names on screen over these, and keeps the recipe's order and completeness.

recipes.title: Sign in to Gemini and ask a first question
recipes.goal: Reach the Gemini prompt box and get one useful answer.

steps.do: Open gemini.google.com in your browser.
steps.label: Gemini
steps.expect: The Gemini page loads.
steps.ifMissing: Type gemini.google.com into the address bar yourself rather than searching for it.

steps.do: Sign in with your Google account if you are asked to.
steps.label: Sign in
steps.expect: Your profile picture shows at the top right.
steps.ifMissing: You may already be signed in; skip this step if your picture is there.

steps.do: Click the prompt box at the bottom and type your question.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: Your words appear in the box.
steps.ifMissing: The box may be labelled with a hint rather than a name; it is the wide box across the bottom.

steps.do: Press Return to send it.
steps.label: Submit
steps.expect: Gemini starts writing an answer.
steps.ifMissing: Click the arrow button at the right end of the prompt box instead.

commonFailures: No prompt box: the account may be a Workspace account whose administrator has turned Gemini off.

recipes.title: Open Canvas to write and edit a draft
recipes.goal: Write and edit a draft side by side with Gemini instead of in the chat.

steps.do: Open gemini.google.com and sign in.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: The prompt box is visible.
steps.ifMissing: Follow the gemini-start recipe first.

steps.do: Below the prompt box, click Add Files.
steps.label: Add Files
steps.expect: A menu of tools opens.
steps.ifMissing: The button may be a plus sign or be labelled Tools; open that menu instead.

steps.do: Choose Canvas from the menu.
steps.label: Canvas
steps.expect: A Canvas chip appears in the prompt box.
steps.ifMissing: If Canvas is not in the menu, the account may not have the feature yet; say so rather than guessing.

steps.do: Type what you want written and press Return.
steps.label: Submit
steps.expect: A Canvas panel opens beside the chat with your draft.
steps.ifMissing: Click the arrow button at the right end of the prompt box.

steps.do: To change part of the draft, select that text, type the change in the prompt box and press Enter.
steps.label: Canvas
steps.expect: Only the selected text changes, and the draft saves itself.

commonFailures: Canvas missing from the menu: the account may not have the feature yet.
Edits lost: Canvas saves as you go, so re-open the same chat rather than starting a new one.

recipes.title: Send a Canvas draft to Google Docs
recipes.goal: Move a finished Canvas draft into a real Google Doc you can keep and share.

steps.do: Open the Canvas chat that holds your draft.
steps.label: Canvas
steps.expect: The draft shows in the Canvas panel.
steps.ifMissing: Follow the gemini-open-canvas recipe first.

steps.do: At the top right of the Canvas panel, click Share & export.
steps.label: Share & export
steps.expect: A short menu opens.
steps.ifMissing: Look for an upload or three-dot button in the same corner.

steps.do: Choose Export to Docs.
steps.label: Export to Docs
steps.expect: A new Google Doc opens in another tab with your text.
steps.ifMissing: Choose Share instead and copy the link if there is no Docs option.

commonFailures: Nothing opens: the browser may have blocked the new tab; allow pop-ups for gemini.google.com.

recipes.title: Share a Canvas creation by link
recipes.goal: Give someone else a link to what you made in Canvas.

steps.do: Open the Canvas chat that holds your creation.
steps.label: Canvas
steps.expect: The creation shows in the Canvas panel.

steps.do: At the top right, click Share & export.
steps.label: Share & export
steps.expect: A short menu opens.

steps.do: Choose Share.
steps.label: Share
steps.expect: A link beginning g.co/gemini/share appears.

steps.do: Click Copy link and paste it where you want to share it.
steps.label: Copy link
steps.expect: The link is on your clipboard.
steps.ifMissing: Select the link text and copy it with Command-C on a Mac or Ctrl-C on Windows.

commonFailures: The person cannot open it: sharing may be limited on a Workspace account.

recipes.title: Create a Skill, reusable instructions Gemini follows every time
recipes.goal: Save instructions once as a Gemini Skill (技能) and use them again in any chat with @.

requires.notes: Skills replace the older Gems. Gemini may show the Chinese names in brackets.

steps.do: In Gemini's left bar, click Customize (自訂), the round icon under the clock.
steps.label: Customize
steps.expect: The Customize Gemini page (自訂 Gemini) opens with Explore, Connectors and Skills tabs (探索, 連接器, 技能).
steps.ifMissing: With the sidebar open it is the 自訂 row. Or type gemini.google.com/customize/skills in the address bar and press Return.

steps.do: Click the Skills tab (技能) at the top.
steps.label: Skills
steps.expect: The Skills page lists recommended skills and a Create button (建立).
steps.ifMissing: The tab may read 技能 when Gemini is in Chinese.

steps.do: Click Create (建立) beside the search box.
steps.label: Create
steps.expect: A menu opens: Create with Gemini, Create manually and Upload (運用 Gemini 建立, 手動建立, 上傳).

steps.do: Choose Create manually (手動建立).
steps.label: Create manually
steps.expect: An empty skill form opens with Name, Description and Instructions.
steps.ifMissing: Create with Gemini (運用 Gemini 建立) also works: describe the skill and Gemini drafts it.

steps.do: In the name box at the top, type the skill's name.
steps.label: Name
steps.expect: The name shows at the top of the form.
steps.ifMissing: The box says 為技能命名 when Gemini is in Chinese.

steps.do: In Description (說明), write one sentence on what the skill is for.
steps.label: Description
steps.expect: The sentence shows under Description.
steps.ifMissing: The box is labelled 說明.

steps.do: In Instructions (使用說明), write what Gemini must do: the role, the task, the rules and the format you want back.
steps.label: Instructions
steps.expect: Your instructions fill the large box.
steps.ifMissing: The box is labelled 使用說明.

steps.do: Click Create (建立) at the top right to save the skill.
steps.label: Create
steps.expect: The button changes to Saved (已儲存).
steps.ifMissing: Look for Save (儲存) in the same corner.

commonFailures: No Skills tab: a Workspace administrator may have turned the feature off; paste the instructions at the start of each new chat instead.
recipes.verifiedWith: Followed in Gemini on the web (Traditional Chinese interface, personal account) in the team's recordings of 16 Oct 2026.

recipes.title: Use a Skill you saved
recipes.goal: Start a chat that follows one of your saved skills.

steps.do: Click New chat (發起新對話) at the top of the left bar.
steps.label: New chat
steps.expect: An empty chat opens with the prompt box.
steps.ifMissing: Click the pencil icon at the top of the left bar.

steps.do: In the prompt box, type @ and choose your skill from the list.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: Your skill's name shows in the prompt box.
steps.ifMissing: Type: Use my skill, followed by its name.

steps.do: Type your request and press Return.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: Gemini answers and shows the skill it used.

commonFailures: The answer ignores the rules: check the skill's name showed in the prompt box before sending.
recipes.verifiedWith: Followed in Gemini on the web (Traditional Chinese interface, personal account) in the team's recordings of 16 Oct 2026.

recipes.title: Extract invoice fields with a Gemini Skill, check them, then paste verified rows into Excel
recipes.goal: Save an Invoice Review skill, upload invoices, check Gemini's rows against the invoices and paste only checked rows into an Excel staging sheet.

requires.notes: Up to 10 files can be attached to one prompt, subject to availability; if a batch is refused, send three and then two with the same skill.

steps.do: In Gemini's left bar, click Customize (自訂), the round icon under the clock.
steps.label: Customize
steps.expect: The Customize Gemini page (自訂 Gemini) opens with Explore, Connectors and Skills tabs (探索, 連接器, 技能).
steps.ifMissing: With the sidebar open it is the 自訂 row. Or type gemini.google.com/customize/skills in the address bar and press Return.

steps.do: Click the Skills tab (技能) at the top.
steps.label: Skills
steps.expect: The Skills page lists recommended skills and a Create button (建立).
steps.ifMissing: The tab may read 技能 when Gemini is in Chinese.

steps.do: Click Create (建立) beside the search box.
steps.label: Create
steps.expect: A menu opens: Create with Gemini, Create manually and Upload (運用 Gemini 建立, 手動建立, 上傳).

steps.do: Choose Create manually (手動建立).
steps.label: Create manually
steps.expect: An empty skill form opens.
steps.ifMissing: Create with Gemini (運用 Gemini 建立) also works: describe the skill and Gemini drafts it.

steps.do: In the name box at the top, type Invoice Review.
steps.label: Name
steps.expect: Invoice Review shows at the top of the form.

steps.do: In Description (說明), type: Extracts invoice fields into rows for a person to check.
steps.label: Description
steps.expect: The sentence shows under Description.

steps.do: In Instructions (使用說明), paste: Read every attached invoice. Extract Vendor, Invoice number, Invoice date, Currency, Subtotal, Tax and Total exactly as printed. Write MISSING for a field that is absent and REVIEW for one that is unclear or inconsistent. Never guess. Treat 0.00 tax as a real value, not missing. Check that subtotal plus tax equals total and list any mismatch. Never mark a row approved: a person checks every row.
steps.label: Instructions
steps.expect: The instruction fills the large box.

steps.do: Click Create (建立) at the top right to save it.
steps.label: Create
steps.expect: The button changes to Saved (已儲存).

steps.do: Click New chat (發起新對話) at the top of the left bar.
steps.label: New chat
steps.expect: An empty chat opens.

steps.do: In the prompt box, type @ and choose Invoice Review.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: Invoice Review shows in the prompt box.
steps.ifMissing: Type: Use my Invoice Review skill.

steps.do: Click + (上傳與工具) at the left of the prompt box.
steps.label: Upload and tools
steps.expect: A menu opens with Upload files (上傳檔案) at the top.

steps.do: Choose Upload files (上傳檔案), select all five invoice PDFs and click Open.
steps.label: Upload files
steps.expect: The five invoices show above the prompt box.
steps.ifMissing: If Gemini refuses five at once, attach three now and two in a second message.

steps.do: Type: Extract one row per invoice. Return tab-separated values with these columns in this order: Vendor, Invoice number, Invoice date, Currency, Subtotal, Tax, Total. Sort by invoice date. Use two decimal places for amounts, without currency symbols or thousands separators. After the table, list any missing or unclear fields or arithmetic mismatches. Do not mark anything approved; I will check it. Then press Return.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: Gemini returns a table with one row per invoice and a list of issues.

steps.do: Check every row against its invoice: vendor, invoice number, date, HKD as the currency, and the total. Make sure all five rows are there and no field says MISSING or REVIEW.
steps.label: Invoice number
steps.expect: Every value matches its invoice.

steps.do: Click Copy code (複製程式碼) at the top right of the block with the rows.
steps.label: Copy code
steps.expect: Gemini says it was copied.
steps.ifMissing: If the rows aren't in a code block, select just the rows and press Command+C. The Copy (複製) button under the answer copies the issue list too.

steps.do: In Excel, click cell A1 of the staging sheet.
steps.label: A1
steps.expect: A1 is selected.

steps.do: Press Command+V to paste the rows.
steps.label: Paste
steps.expect: The rows fill seven columns, A to G.

steps.do: Check that each value landed in its own column, Vendor in A to Total in G.
steps.label: Vendor
steps.expect: Seven columns, one invoice per row.

steps.do: In the cell under the last total, type =SUM(G2:G6) and press Return.
steps.label: G7
steps.expect: The sum matches the invoices' totals added by hand.

commonFailures: Everything lands in column A: the copy wasn't tab-separated; ask Gemini to return tab-separated values again.
Tax shows MISSING for 0.00: the instruction must say that 0.00 tax is a real value.
recipes.verifiedWith: Followed in Gemini on the web (Traditional Chinese interface, personal account) in the team's recordings of 16 Oct 2026. Excel steps follow the team's demo plan.

recipes.title: Run a Deep Research report
recipes.goal: Get a longer researched report with sources instead of a short chat answer.

steps.do: Open gemini.google.com and sign in.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: The prompt box is visible.

steps.do: Below the prompt box, click Add Files.
steps.label: Add Files
steps.expect: A menu of tools opens.
steps.ifMissing: The button may be a plus sign or be labelled Tools.

steps.do: Choose Deep Research.
steps.label: Deep Research
steps.expect: A Deep Research chip appears in the prompt box.
steps.ifMissing: If it is not listed, the account may not have the feature yet.

steps.do: Type your research question and press Return.
steps.label: Submit
steps.expect: Gemini shows a research plan for you to check.

steps.do: Read the plan, and click Edit plan if you want it changed.
steps.label: Edit plan
steps.expect: The plan opens for editing.
steps.ifMissing: Skip this step to accept the plan as written.

steps.do: Click Start research.
steps.label: Start research
steps.expect: Gemini begins working; this usually takes five to ten minutes.
steps.ifMissing: You can leave the chat and come back.

steps.do: When the report is ready, click Open.
steps.label: Open
steps.expect: The finished report opens with its sources.

commonFailures: It takes longer than ten minutes on a broad topic; leaving the chat does not cancel it.

recipes.title: Ask Gemini about a file you upload
recipes.goal: Get a summary or answers from a document or picture of your own.

steps.do: Open gemini.google.com and sign in.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: The prompt box is visible.

steps.do: Below the prompt box, click Add Files.
steps.label: Add Files
steps.expect: A menu opens.
steps.ifMissing: The button may be a plus sign or a paperclip.

steps.do: Choose Files and pick the file from your computer.
steps.label: Files
steps.expect: The file's name shows above the prompt box.
steps.ifMissing: You may be offered Google Drive as well as your computer.

steps.do: Type what you want done with it and press Return.
steps.label: Submit
steps.expect: Gemini answers from the file's contents.
steps.ifMissing: Say what you want plainly, for example summarise this in five bullet points.

commonFailures: The file is refused: it may be too large or an unsupported type.
Answers ignore the file: check the file's name is still shown above the prompt box.

recipes.title: Schedule a recurring action
recipes.goal: Have Gemini do something on a schedule, such as a weekly summary.

steps.do: Open gemini.google.com and sign in.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: The prompt box is visible.

steps.do: Type the task and when it should run, for example every Monday at 9am summarise my week, then press Return.
steps.label: Submit
steps.expect: Gemini replies with a summary of the scheduled action.
steps.ifMissing: Say the day and the time plainly in the same sentence as the task.

steps.do: To check or change it later, click your profile picture, then Scheduled actions.
steps.label: Scheduled actions
steps.expect: Your scheduled actions are listed.
steps.ifMissing: It may sit under Settings; you can also ask Gemini to change the action in its own chat.

commonFailures: Nothing is scheduled: Keep Activity must be on for this feature to work.
You can have at most ten active scheduled actions at a time.

recipes.title: Ask Gemini inside a Google Doc
recipes.goal: Draft or rewrite text without leaving the document.

requires.plan: paid Google Workspace or Google AI plan on some accounts

steps.do: Open your document at docs.google.com.
steps.label: Google Docs
steps.expect: The document opens.

steps.do: At the top right, click Ask Gemini.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: The Gemini side panel opens.
steps.ifMissing: Look for the star-shaped Gemini button in the same corner; it is hidden when the account has no Gemini plan.

steps.do: In the side panel, choose a suggested prompt or write your own, then press Enter.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: Gemini writes a suggestion in the panel.

steps.do: Click Insert to put the text into your document.
steps.label: Insert
steps.expect: The text appears in the document.
steps.ifMissing: Click Retry for another version first if the suggestion is not right.

commonFailures: No Ask Gemini button: the account's plan or its administrator may not include Gemini in Workspace.

recipes.title: Generate slides with Gemini in Google Slides
recipes.goal: Turn a description into slides inside a Google Slides presentation.

requires.plan: paid Google Workspace or Google AI plan on some accounts

steps.do: Open your presentation at slides.google.com.
steps.label: Google Slides
steps.expect: The presentation opens.

steps.do: At the top right, click Ask Gemini.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: The Gemini side panel opens.
steps.ifMissing: Look for the star-shaped Gemini button in the same corner.

steps.do: Describe the slides you want and press Enter.
steps.label: Ask Gemini
steps.expect: Gemini drafts slide content in the panel.

steps.do: Click Insert to add the generated slide to your presentation.
steps.label: Insert

recipes.title: Create a notebook and add your sources
recipes.goal: Ask questions that are answered only from documents you choose, with citations.

steps.do: Open notebooklm.google.com and sign in with your Google account.
steps.label: NotebookLM
steps.expect: The notebooks page opens.

steps.do: Click Create new notebook.
steps.label: Create new notebook
steps.expect: A source picker opens.
steps.ifMissing: Look for a plus button or New notebook on the same page.

steps.do: Add your sources: PDFs, Google Docs, websites or YouTube links.
steps.label: Add sources
steps.expect: Each source is listed down the left.
steps.ifMissing: You can drag files onto the picker instead.

steps.do: Type a question in the chat box and press Return.
steps.label: Chat
steps.expect: The answer appears with numbered citations to your sources.
steps.ifMissing: Answers come only from your sources, so add the document first if a fact is missing.

commonFailures: A source is refused: it may be too large or behind a sign-in.
Answers say nothing is found: the fact may not be in the sources you added.

recipes.title: Draft a document with Copilot in Word
recipes.goal: Get a first draft written into a Word document.

steps.do: Open a blank document in Word, or put your cursor where the new text should go.
steps.label: Word
steps.expect: The cursor is where you want the text.

steps.do: Open Copilot at the bottom right corner of the document.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: A Copilot prompt box opens.
steps.ifMissing: There is also a Copilot button on the Home tab of the ribbon; use that if the corner shows nothing.

steps.do: Describe what you want, saying the topic, who it is for, the tone, the format and the length.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: Your description shows in the prompt box.

steps.do: Click Generate.
steps.label: Generate
steps.expect: Copilot writes a draft into the document.
steps.ifMissing: Press Return to send the prompt instead.

steps.do: Read the draft, then keep it, discard it, or type a follow-up to change it.
steps.label: Keep it
steps.expect: The draft stays in the document once you keep it.
steps.ifMissing: The buttons may read Keep, Discard and Regenerate; pick the one that matches what you want.

commonFailures: No Copilot button: the account has no Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
Always check facts, numbers and names in a Copilot draft before sending it.

recipes.title: Draft in Word from one of your own files
recipes.goal: Base a Word draft on a document you already have instead of on nothing.

steps.do: Open a blank document in Word.
steps.label: Word
steps.expect: An empty document is open.

steps.do: Open Copilot at the bottom right corner.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: A Copilot prompt box opens.
steps.ifMissing: Use the Copilot button on the Home tab if the corner shows nothing.

steps.do: Type a forward slash, then choose the file you want to draft from.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: The file's name appears in the prompt box.
steps.ifMissing: The file must be in OneDrive or SharePoint for Copilot to find it; upload it there first.

steps.do: Say what you want made from it, then click Generate.
steps.label: Generate
steps.expect: Copilot drafts from that file's contents.

commonFailures: The file is not offered: it may be stored only on this computer rather than in OneDrive or SharePoint.

recipes.title: Get insights about a table with Copilot in Excel
recipes.goal: Have Copilot find summaries, trends and outliers in a table of numbers.

steps.do: Open your workbook in Excel and click any cell inside the table.
steps.label: Excel
steps.expect: The table is on screen.
steps.ifMissing: Copilot works best when the data is a proper table with headings.

steps.do: On the Home tab of the ribbon, click Copilot.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: The Copilot pane opens at the side.
steps.ifMissing: Look for the Copilot icon at the right-hand end of the Home tab.

steps.do: Ask for what you want in your own words, for example compare Q1 and Q2 sales.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: Your question shows in the pane.
steps.ifMissing: Be specific: name the columns or the period you mean. Say PivotTable if you want one.

steps.do: Press Return and read the insights Copilot returns.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: Charts, PivotTables, summaries, trends or outliers appear.

commonFailures: No Copilot button: the account has no Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
Vague answers: ask about named columns instead of the whole sheet.

recipes.title: Create a presentation from a file with Copilot in PowerPoint

steps.do: Edit the slides, and ask Copilot for more slides if you need them.

steps.expect: The deck matches what you need.

recipes.title: Turn a Copilot Page into a Word document
recipes.goal: Keep a finished page as a Word file you can send or print.

recipes.title: Build your own Copilot agent
recipes.goal: Make a reusable assistant with your own instructions and knowledge.

steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: Copilot opens.

steps.do: In the navigation pane, under Agents, click New agent.
steps.label: New agent
steps.expect: Agent Builder opens.
steps.ifMissing: Look for Agents down the left; the button may read Create agent.

steps.do: Describe what the agent should do and click Send.
steps.label: Send
steps.expect: The agent's name, description and instructions fill in as you talk to it.

steps.do: Open the Configure tab to set the name, description, instructions and suggested prompts yourself.
steps.label: Configure
steps.expect: Your wording shows in the form.

steps.do: Add what it should know: SharePoint items, public websites or your work messages and email.
steps.label: Knowledge
steps.expect: Each source is listed under Knowledge.
steps.ifMissing: Only connectors your organisation has turned on will be offered.

steps.do: Try the agent on the Try it tab, then refine its instructions.
steps.label: Try it
steps.expect: The agent answers the way you intended.

commonFailures: No New agent button: the account has no Microsoft 365 Copilot licence, or an administrator has turned agents off.
The agent ignores a source: check it is listed under Knowledge and that you can open it yourself.

recipes.title: Give a Copilot agent a SharePoint site to read
recipes.goal: Ground an agent in your team's own documents so its answers cite them.

steps.do: Open your agent in Agent Builder and go to the Configure tab.
steps.label: Configure
steps.expect: The agent's form is on screen.
steps.ifMissing: Make the agent first with the m365-copilot-build-agent recipe.

steps.do: Under Knowledge, add a SharePoint source.
steps.label: Knowledge
steps.expect: A picker for SharePoint sites and files opens.
steps.ifMissing: The button may read Add knowledge or Add source.

steps.do: Pick the site, library or file the agent should read.
steps.label: SharePoint
steps.expect: The source is listed under Knowledge.
steps.ifMissing: You can only add what your own account is allowed to open.

steps.do: Save the agent, then ask it a question on the Try it tab.
steps.label: Try it
steps.expect: The answer cites the SharePoint documents.

commonFailures: The agent cannot see a document: the agent only reads what the person asking is already allowed to open.

recipes.title: Find Copilot in your Microsoft 365 apps
recipes.goal: Know where the Copilot button is in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.

steps.do: Open Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook or Teams and sign in with your work or Microsoft account.
steps.label: Sign in
steps.expect: Your name shows at the top right of the app.

steps.do: Look on the Home tab of the ribbon for the Copilot button.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: The Copilot pane opens when clicked.
steps.ifMissing: In Word the prompt also appears at the bottom right of the page; in Outlook and Teams it sits in the toolbar.

steps.do: Type what you want in your own words and read the result.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: Copilot answers about what is open.
steps.ifMissing: Say what you want plainly, for example summarise this document.

commonFailures: No Copilot button anywhere: the account has no Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
The button is greyed out: the file may be stored only on this computer rather than in OneDrive or SharePoint.

recipes.title: Open Microsoft Copilot on the web and ask a question
recipes.goal: Reach the free Microsoft Copilot assistant and get one useful answer.

steps.do: Open copilot.microsoft.com in your browser.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: The Copilot page loads.
steps.ifMissing: Type the address yourself rather than searching for it.

steps.do: Sign in with your Microsoft account to keep your chats.
steps.label: Sign in
steps.expect: Your initial shows at the top right.
steps.ifMissing: You can ask questions without signing in, but the chats are not kept.

steps.do: Type or speak your question in the message box.
steps.label: Message Copilot
steps.expect: Your words appear in the box.
steps.ifMissing: The box sits across the bottom of the page; it may show a hint rather than a name.

steps.do: Press Return to send it.
steps.label: Submit
steps.expect: Copilot writes an answer, often with links to its sources.
steps.ifMissing: Click the arrow at the right end of the message box.

commonFailures: A work or school sign-in may open the work version at copilot.cloud.microsoft instead, which looks different.

recipes.title: Create an image with Microsoft Copilot
recipes.goal: Make a picture from a description, free, in the web assistant.

steps.do: Open copilot.microsoft.com and sign in.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: The message box is visible.

steps.do: Describe the picture you want and say you want an image, then press Return.
steps.label: Message Copilot
steps.expect: Copilot makes one or more pictures.
steps.ifMissing: Say the subject, the style and the mood plainly, for example draw a watercolour of a harbour at dawn.

steps.do: Click a picture to see it larger, then save or share it from there.
steps.label: Copilot
steps.expect: The picture opens at full size with save and share options.

commonFailures: Nothing is made: there is a daily limit on free image creation, and some subjects are refused.

recipes.title: Create a first agent in Copilot Studio
recipes.goal: Build a custom agent with its own knowledge and publish it to Teams.

steps.do: Open copilotstudio.microsoft.com and sign in with your work account.
steps.label: Copilot Studio
steps.expect: The Copilot Studio home page opens.

steps.do: Click Create and describe the agent you want.
steps.label: Create
steps.expect: A new agent is set up from your description.
steps.ifMissing: You may be offered a blank agent or a template; either works.

steps.do: Add knowledge: the files or websites it should read.
steps.label: Knowledge
steps.expect: Each source is listed for the agent.
steps.ifMissing: The section may read Add knowledge or Sources.

steps.do: Test the agent in the test panel at the side.
steps.label: Test
steps.expect: The agent answers from the knowledge you added.
steps.ifMissing: The panel may be opened with a Test your agent button.

steps.do: Click Publish, then add the agent to Teams or a website.
steps.label: Publish
steps.expect: The agent is available where you published it.
steps.ifMissing: Publishing can need an administrator's approval in some organisations.

commonFailures: No Create button: Copilot Studio needs a work account and a licence or trial.
Publishing is blocked: an administrator may have to approve the agent first.
